arc.premise: Auroben wants to prove the city gardens' worst plot - the one everyone quietly blames on the old 882 d.V. curse - can still grow something whole. He's heard, secondhand and unconfirmed, that a gardener two generations back managed one good harvest there before giving up on it again; if true, it's been done before, and he means to do it again this season rather than just keep the soil turned over and call it managed.
